text:
alex: Heads up — customers reporting a lot of "pending credits" on invoices. I traced it to the metering-ingest -> ack path. Events are arriving fast but the pipeline is holding finalization for ~20-90s, console shows unbilled tokens in the UI and then invoices reconcile later. Anyone seen this pattern?

maya: saw a couple tickets about this this morning. UI shows a big Pending column and PMs think it's a bug.

tony: not a bug per se, just the ACK window. We're buffering until KV cache flush + dedupe window to avoid double-billing on replays. But 90s seems high.

priya: this is customer-facing billing noise — legal asked if we have SLA for invoice visibility. Need to be clear in console messaging.

alex: exactly. My worry is UX + customers opening disputes when invoice shows +X tokens at 14:00 and -X at 15:00. Can we add a consumer-facing note like "events may be pending up to N seconds"?

dan: small proposal: emit a "prelim_credit" event immediately for UI only, and a final "billing_credit" when commit/ack completes. That way console shows an optimistic number and finalizes later.

maya: 👍 would reduce panic. But how would we avoid double counting in backend?

tony: prelim events would be tagged with ephemeral_id + provisional=true. The billing pipeline only consumes events with provisional=false except the UI aggregation service can show both. Need to ensure downstream aggregation ignores prelim for invoices.

priya: we must keep audit trail. If we emit prelim events they need to be non-billable and clearly labeled in logs/exports. Auditors will ask.

sam: timeline? Also worried about telemetry explosion if we emit double events per request.

alex: telemetry cost is acceptable compared to customer support load. But implementation must be cheap.

tony: quick sketch — change ingest stage to do: 1) calculate tokens -> emit ui_event(prelim_count) 2) write to kafka topic "metering-raw" 3) once consumer confirms idempotent commit -> emit billing_event(final_count) 4) mark offsets.

ingest-bot: commit log: partition=12 offset=893421 ack_ts=2026-03-19T14:03:05Z topic=metering-raw

dan: question about sequence numbers — if we emit prelim then crash before writing raw, UI will show tokens that never existed. Need monotonic provisional ids + TTL so UI can expire them.

tony: agree. Provisional events should have ttl_ms and a reconciler that clears stale prelims after window_expires. Also include last_ack_ts in UI.

maya: UX asks for two changes: 1) show "last ack" timestamp per tenant, 2) show pending_count with a tooltip "preliminary — may change after reconciliation". Simple and quick.

priya: +1 on tooltip. Also add link to invoice reconciliation docs and contact support flow.

sam: for telemetry, emit a simple metric metering.prelim_emitted with tags {tenant, region}. That keeps costs small.

alex: rollouts — can we canary this for 10% of tenants, compare invoice deltas and support tickets?

tony: yes. Add flag metering.prelim_ui=true in feature flags. Start with internal tenants + small customers.

dan: we'll need dashboards: 1) prelim vs final delta over time 2) stale preliminary count 3) avg ack latency by partition. I can add panels.

ingest-bot: alert: partition=7 lag_jump=+15k at 2026-03-19T14:10:12Z

maya: runbook note: if lag_jump correlates with prelim_emitted spike -> pause prelim rollout.

priya: one more constraint — accounting must guarantee eventual consistency and reconciliation logs exported with invoice. We should add a column in invoice export: provisional_footnote_ts so customers see when a line item was finalized.

alex: sounds good. Action items: Tony to PR metering prelim event + TTL, Dan to add dashboard panels, Maya to update console tooltip + show last_ack, Priya to draft invoice export footnote, Sam to add telemetry metric and rate limit prelim emissions. Canary flag on deploy.

tony: will open PR with design doc, include sample event schema: 

```
{
  "tenant_id": "t_123",
  "ephemeral_id": "p_abcdef",
  "tokens": 120,
  "provisional": true,
  "ttl_ms": 90000,
  "created_ts": "2026-03-19T14:03:10Z"
}
```

maya: perfect. Will add UI mocks for tooltip and last_ack.

priya: I'll circulate the invoice export change + legal note.

alex: thanks all. Let's aim to canary Tuesday and revert if stale prelim > 1% of pending. :thumbsup:

sam: adding feature flag: metering.prelim_ui -> default=false, rollout=10% internal->prod

dan: created dashboard PR in grafana: panels + alert for stale_prelim_count > 1000.

ingest-bot: deployment: metering-ingest v3.12.0 -> canary group 10% started at 2026-03-19T14:20:01Z

maya: will monitor support queue after canary.

alex: closing loop — please drop notes in the rollout doc and set a 24h observation window.

priya: noted.

alex: thanks everyone, feel better about this path.
